@comment: The platform health contract: /healthz answers 200 with exactly {"status":"ok"} and nothing else. This gateway registers its own /healthz (legacy_engine.go) and forces disable_health so lura's /__health cannot also claim a route; the schema below is that endpoint's, not lura's. It used to require lura's agents/now fields — inherited when the spec was retargeted from /__health to /healthz in 5b250d9a and never rewritten — which no build of this gateway has ever satisfied. additionalProperties:false is the point: a probe body must not grow fields that leak internal state.
